faq.heading: FAQ
faq.description: Everything you need to know about working with us.

q1.question: What technologies do you work with?
q1.answer: We specialize in modern web technologies including React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, and Python. For mobile, we work with React Native and Flutter. We choose the best stack based on your project requirements.

q2.question: How long does a typical project take?
q2.answer: Project timelines vary based on scope and complexity. A simple website takes 4-6 weeks, while complex web applications or mobile apps typically take 3-6 months. We'll give you a clear timeline during the proposal phase.

q3.question: What is your pricing model?
q3.answer: We offer both fixed-price and dedicated team models. Fixed-price works best for well-defined projects, while dedicated teams are ideal for ongoing development. Every project starts with a free consultation and detailed proposal.

q4.question: Do you provide post-launch support?
q4.answer: Yes, we offer ongoing maintenance and support packages to keep your software running smoothly. This includes bug fixes, performance monitoring, security updates, and feature enhancements.

q5.question: How do you handle project communication?
q5.answer: We use a combination of async updates and scheduled calls. You'll have a dedicated project manager, access to our project management tools, and weekly progress reports. We adapt to your preferred communication style.

q6.question: Can you work with our existing codebase or team?
q6.answer: Absolutely. We regularly join existing teams or take over ongoing projects. Our engineers are experienced in codebase onboarding and collaborative development across different workflows and tech stacks.

q7.question: What does your development process look like?
q7.answer: We follow an agile methodology with two-week sprints. Each sprint includes planning, development, testing, and a review demo. You'll see working software early and often, with opportunities to refine at every stage.
